description: Resolve any real place ("Palermo, IT", "Sligo", "Bangalore", or geonames:<id>; an island or a country, "Tenerife" or "Malta", is read as its main town or capital, and the answer says so) and fetch its figures from every registry source that covers it: climate (air and feels-like temperature with their spread and extremes, hourly temperature by month, cloud cover, wet days, and day counts: nice, beach, run or ride, muggy, grey, hot nights, heat stress, snow, wind), measured sunshine, air quality, price level, homicides, life expectancy, life satisfaction, research density and official rents. Saved in the person's cache with each figure's URL and time; reused for 30 days unless refresh is set. Returns the city id for compare_cities and get_city, what each source gave, what the place lacks ("Partial data": no tax model for its country, no free-movement rules), and other places the name could mean. Compact by default.

detail.description: "summary" (default): the id, what each source gave, what the place lacks, figures with long series counted. "full": every value and URL

place.description: Place name, optionally with country: "Palermo, IT"; or geonames:<id>

name: fetch_city
title: Fetch any place
